sections.title: Find the Cloud URL
sections.excerpt: Find the Cloud URL | This is the live public URL of the published funnel, using your custom domain when configured. Share it in ads, emails, and landing pages.

sections.title: Copy the URL
sections.excerpt: Copy the URL | Copy the Cloud URL to the clipboard for campaigns and links. The button shows a checkmark to confirm the copy.

sections.title: Test locally with the Debug Panel (dev only)
sections.excerpt: Test locally with the Debug Panel (dev only) | On localhost, a local URL with the Debug Panel shows live variable inspection, analytics preview, and error logs. Use it for QA before release.

sections.title: Open the funnel in a new tab
sections.excerpt: Open the funnel in a new tab | Open the Cloud URL to confirm it loads before sending traffic. It runs with full analytics and Stripe checkout.

sections.title: Complete a smoke test
sections.excerpt: Complete a smoke test | Open the Cloud URL in a clean (incognito) session, complete the flow, confirm analytics events fire, and test the paywall or checkout before sending traffic.
